{"metadata":{"description":"Privacy-minimal heuristic per-turn verification summaries for DeepSeek Harness","id":"gh:1333370288","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-verification-receipt","slug":"030611/dsh-verification-receipt","topics":["agent-infrastructure","deepseek-harness","developer-tools","dsh-plugin","verification"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Privacy-minimal heuristic per-turn verification summaries for DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# DSH Verification Receipt"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> Ask a smaller, checkable question: what verification-shaped execution signals did DSH record this "},{"id":"p4s2","text":" a smaller, checkable question: what verification-shaped execution signals did DSH record this turn?"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"The receipt summarizes recorded tool counts and lexical verification-shaped signals. It does **not**"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" prove that tests ran or that code is correct."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"> Community-maintained and not an official DeepSeek project. Related trust-layer plugins: Telemetry "},{"id":"p7s2","text":"Redactor, Evidence Audit, and Context Provenance."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"DSH Verification Receipt is a small, passive Profile Bundle for DeepSeek Harness. After each durable"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" `turn/end`, it appends one privacy-minimal, heuristic execution summary to a local JSONL file."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"It records execution traces, not semantic correctness. A receipt shows only that DSH logged tool cal"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"ls and that a lexical heuristic found a possible verification signal. It never proves that a test ra"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"n. It cannot show that the right command executed, that assertions were sufficient, that output was "},{"id":"p9s4","text":"truthful, or that the assistant's conclusion was correct."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"This is intentionally not an evidence-audit ledger: rows stay independent and there is no hash chain"},{"id":"p10s2","text":", artifact capture, claim-evidence linkage, or protocol attestation."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Compatibility evidence"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Version 0.1.1 supports exactly DSH `0.1.2-alpha.3`, `0.1.2-alpha.4`, and `0.1.2-alpha.5` on Node.js "},{"id":"p12s2","text":"`^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`. Each release passed local package gates and disposable Windows Web Profile i"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"nstall, composed-config, cold-start, and uninstall acceptance. See the compatibility evidence for th"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"e exact boundary. Cordis and Session are optional host peers because DSH supplies their runtime serv"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"ices; Schemastery is included as an exact runtime dependency and also declared as a compatibility pe"},{"id":"p12s6","text":"s; Schemastery is included as an exact runtime dependency and also declared as a compatibility peer."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"The compatibility evidence above describes source version 0.1.1. A GitHub
version change does not pu"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"blish to npm: check `npm view dsh-verification-receipt version`
before assuming the registry package"},{"id":"p14s3","text":" includes those changes. To use this exact
source version before it is published, build and pack the"},{"id":"p14s4","text":" checkout, then pass
the resulting `.tgz` to `dsh plugin --profile web add`."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Add the published package to every profile that should emit receipts:"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"Repeat the first command with another profile name (for example, `headless`) when that profile also "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"needs receipts. For local development, clone this repository, run `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile &&"},{"id":"p17s3","text":" pnpm run check`, and pass the checkout path to `dsh plugin ... add` instead of the package name."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"The tarball includes compiled JavaScript and TypeScript declarations; consumers
do not need TypeScri"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"pt, esbuild, or a plugin build step. For a standalone
installation, `pnpm add --ignore-scripts dsh-v"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"erification-receipt@<version>`
disables dependency lifecycle scripts (the placeholder must be a publ"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"ished
version). This is a package-manager command, not a DSH CLI option."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"In this source tree, `prepack` runs the build before packing/publishing; there
is no `prepare`, `pre"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"install`, `install`, or `postinstall` hook. A checkout needs
an explicit `pnpm run build` or `pnpm r"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"un check` after dependency installation.
Git-source dependencies are not a script-free installation "},{"id":"p19s4","text":"path: package
managers can run `prepack` while preparing them. Prefer a prebuilt registry
package or"},{"id":"p19s5","text":" reviewed tarball. See SECURITY.md."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"`package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch`; `cordis.patch.yml` inserts one ordinary observer plugin."},{"id":"p20s2","text":" It works on any DSH surface that provides the core Session service."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## Output"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Privacy and agent behavior"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"The persisted receipt does not contain:"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"- tool arguments or call ids;
- tool result content or error messages;
- assistant or user message t"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"ext;
- raw session ids, working directories, provider names, or model names."},{"id":"p26s1","text":"The plugin temporarily reads tool names, raw arguments, and result status from existing durable even"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"ts to compute the summary. It does not persist those inputs, append a Session event, register a tool"},{"id":"p26s3","text":", add a prompt section, inject context, make a model call, or change model history."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"`sessionIdHash` is deterministic, unkeyed, and domain-separated so receipts from one Session can be "},{"id":"p27s2","text":"grouped without storing its raw id. It is linkable across files. If a Session id is predictable or l"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"ow entropy, an observer can guess candidates offline and recompute the hash; this is pseudonymizatio"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"n, not anonymization."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"- Receipts cover events observed by the running plugin. Constructor seed history and turns completed"},{"id":"p29s2","text":" while it was unloaded are not backfilled.
- A process crash can lose a queued receipt because `turn"},{"id":"p29s3","text":"/end` does not synchronously wait for this optional local sink. Normal plugin/application disposal d"},{"id":"p29s4","text":"rains accepted writes.
- Disposal first closes the enqueue gate, then unregisters listeners, then dr"},{"id":"p29s5","text":"ains accepted writes. Abrupt process termination cannot run that lifecycle.
- Receipt rows are indep"},{"id":"p29s6","text":"endent; deletion, reordering, truncation, and rollback are not detectable.
- Receipt status repeats "},{"id":"p29s7","text":"DSH's recorded tool outcome and recognized shell markers. It does not independently execute or valid"},{"id":"p29s8","text":"ate anything.
- Projection cost grows with the number and size of events in a turn; unusually large "},{"id":"p29s9","text":"tool arguments can add end-of-turn CPU time while they are classified in memory.
- The in-process wr"},{"id":"p29s10","text":"ite queue is ordered but unbounded. A slow or stuck filesystem can grow memory usage until writes re"},{"id":"p29s11","text":"cover or the process ends.
- There is no cross-process lock. Two DSH processes targeting one file ha"},{"id":"p29s12","text":"ve no guaranteed row order or row-boundary integrity; use one file per process. A crash can leave an"},{"id":"p29s13","text":" incomplete final line, which readers must reject or quarantine.
- Creation modes request `0700`/`06"},{"id":"p29s14","text":"00` on supporting POSIX filesystems only. Existing permissions are not tightened, Windows may ignore"},{"id":"p29s15","text":" POSIX modes, and pre-existing symbolic links are followed. Configure a trusted, private, non-symlin"},{"id":"p29s16","text":"k path.
- The file has no built-in rotation, retention, encryption, signing, or recovery."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"See SECURITY.md for the trust and disclosure model."}],"truncated":true}
